flow_summary: The interviewer showed almost no recovery or redirection for this confused, disorganised patient. Vague or muddled answers (current concerns, address, name format) were ignored or bypassed; after the patient said “I don’t think so—nothing like that” for biological treatments, the system still asked four follow-up detail questions. The single clear question rule was followed, but active guidance was absent.

issues.evidence: After patient said “sleep has been off, but—sorry—do you mean the main reason… or what’s been bothering me day to day? I get a bit muddled”, interviewer switched to “What do you hope to get out of your appointment?” without clarifying.

Patient answered biological-treatment question with “I don’t think so—nothing like that, no.” Interviewer then asked “When was it received?”, “Where was it received?”, “Approximately how many sessions?”, and “How long did the benefit last?”
Patient expressed uncertainty about address number and DOB format; interviewer moved on without obtaining or confirming the missing details.
